bias.zh: 区间整理 · 小幅跌破 10 日均线，守住 $135–136.6

read.en: SpaceX fell 1.3% on Nov 16 to $137.36, trading $135.73–139.98. It is just below the 10-day ($137.6) and below the 5-day ($139.9, rising), 30-day ($147.0) and 100-day ($142.3, falling); there is no 200-day yet (109 sessions). MACD has been above its signal since Nov 12, below zero, histogram small; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 11 ($122.98), and RSI is 44.9.
read.zh: SpaceX 11月16日下跌 1.3%，收于 $137.36，盘中区间 $135.73–139.98。股价略低于 10 日均线（$137.6），并位于 5 日（$139.9，上行）、30 日（$147.0）和 100 日均线（$142.3，下行）下方；上市仅 109 个交易日，尚无 200 日均线。MACD 自 11月12日起位于信号线上方，在零轴下方，柱状图较小；抛物线 SAR 自 11月11日起看多（$122.98），RSI 为 44.9。

read.en: The close slipped under the 10-day, now resistance, but the $135.73 low held the $135.4–136.6 band (Nov 9 and 13 lows). Resistance is $137.6–140 (10 and 5-day, Nov 13 close, Nov 16 high), then $140.7–142.3 (Oct 15 low, Nov 13 high, 100-day) and $143.2–145.2. Support is $135.4–136.6, then $134.3–134.5 (Nov 6 close, Oct 30 low) and $130.2–131.9. A close above $140 would target $141–142.3; below $135.4, $134.3.

r.en: Nov 9 high $143.2; Nov 10 high $144.89; Nov 11 high $145.16; Nov 12 high $147.60

s.en: Aug 10 and Aug 20 lows ($130.2–130.4); Nov 5 high $131.87
